license_text: People are free to copy the files here and put them on your own web sites. The music is all public domain, and good ABC transcriptions shouldn't add anything (other than clarifying some things by using modern notation), so it's not obvious that ABC like you'll find here is even subject to copyright. It's merely a transcription to a different medium, and the real "value added" is availability.
